description: The CodeBoarding-action architecture is a stateful pipeline that transforms raw code changes into architectural insights. It orchestrates a flow from environment validation and structural analysis to differential visualization and developer-centric reporting, utilizing a baseline-driven incremental diffing approach to optimize LLM processing.

components.name: Action Orchestrator
components.description: Acts as the central controller and entry point. It manages the GitHub Action lifecycle, validates the environment, and implements the logic to decide between a full re-analysis or an incremental update based on existing baselines.

components.name: Execution Lifecycle Controller
components.description: Acts as the primary entry point and state machine for the GitHub Action, sequencing execution phases from setup to rendering.

components.name: Strategy & Metadata Manager
components.description: Implements the decision engine for incremental versus full analysis and manages persistence of architectural metadata.

components.name: Validation & Health Guardrails
components.description: Ensures architectural synchronization integrity by validating baseline drift and generating health metrics.

components.name: Structural Analyzer & Documenter
components.description: Performs deep inspection of the codebase to map the project structure. It identifies components, methods, and file relationships, filtering for "touched" files to ensure only relevant changes are processed for documentation.

components.name: Codebase Explorer & Metadata Extractor
components.description: Performs the initial traversal of the project directory to identify files and extract granular metadata, such as method definitions and relationship keys.

components.name: Change Detection Engine
components.description: The core logic for incremental updates that compares the current structural state against a baseline to identify structural modifications.

components.name: Documentation Generator & Orchestrator
components.description: Manages the high-level execution flow, renders component-level documentation, and generates final integration artifacts like GitHub CTA links.

components.name: Diffing & Visualization Engine
components.description: The logic core that compares the current structural analysis against the baseline. It identifies additions, deletions, and modifications in the architecture and translates these changes into Mermaid.js syntax for visual rendering.

components.name: Structural Diff Engine
components.description: Identifies additions, deletions, and modifications by comparing the current architectural analysis against the baseline to calculate the delta.

components.name: Mermaid Syntax Renderer
components.description: Translates calculated differences into Mermaid.js class diagram syntax with visual styling based on change status.

components.name: Architectural Scope Manager
components.description: Maintains hierarchical context and naming integrity to ensure components are uniquely identified and correctly nested.

components.name: Integration & Feedback Provider
components.description: Finalizes the process by generating user-facing outputs. It creates the "Call to Action" (CTA) for PR comments, generates webview links for interactive diagrams, and detects local editor settings to provide deep-linking capabilities.

components.name: CTA Orchestrator
components.description: Generates the final Markdown 'Call to Action' block for Pull Request comments by aggregating health status, interactive links, and instructional text.

components.name: Environment Resolver
components.description: Detects local developer configurations to enable 'Open in IDE' functionality by mapping editor markers to URI schemes.

components.name: Webview Link Generator
components.description: Constructs parameters and URLs for viewing architectural changes in the hosted CodeBoarding web application.
